definitions.explanation: Short for 生活協同組合 (consumer cooperative association). A membership-based organization where consumers pool resources to purchase goods and services at favorable prices. Very common in Japanese daily life, especially university co-ops and home delivery services.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生協|せいきょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought textbooks at the university co-op.

examples.japanese: {生協|せいきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宅配|たくはい}→宅配：09571_takuhai⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}している→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I use the co-op's home delivery service.

examples.japanese: {生協|せいきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧や⟦{日用品|にちようひん}→日用品：09547_nichiyouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}→割引価格：25782_waribikikakaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ほか、{共済|きょうさい}⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{入|はい}れる→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: By joining the co-op, you can purchase food and daily necessities at discounted prices and also sign up for mutual insurance.

notes:
USAGE:
{生協|せいきょう} is the standard abbreviation for ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦{協同|きょうどう}{組合|くみあい}→協同組合：24675_kyoudoukumiai⟧ (consumer cooperative association). In Japan, co-ops are extremely common — most universities have a co-op (⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧{生協|せいきょう}) that sells textbooks, stationery, and food. Regional co-ops like コープ (CO-OP) offer grocery delivery services that are widely used by families.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧{生協|せいきょう} (university co-op)
- {生協|せいきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宅配|たくはい}→宅配：09571_takuhai⟧ (co-op delivery)
- {生協|せいきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧ (join a co-op)
- {生協|せいきょう}⟦{食堂|しょくどう}→食堂：01054_shokudou⟧ (co-op cafeteria)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{組合|くみあい}→組合：02669_kumiai⟧: union, cooperative (broader term for any cooperative or labor union)
- コープ: co-op (brand name used by many Japanese consumer cooperatives)
- ⟦{協同|きょうどう}{組合|くみあい}→協同組合：24675_kyoudoukumiai⟧: cooperative association (formal, unabbreviated term)
